text:
Alex Chen: Hey folks — we had a foster placement last week (placement date 2026-08-17). What's the process to add the child to medical/dental? Any specific docs? Do we get retroactive coverage to placement date?
Maria (People Ops): Congrats Alex! :tada: Short answer: yes, you can enroll under a qualifying life event. Please submit within 30 days for best effective date options.
Jamie (Benefits): Required docs: county placement letter or social worker verification, foster placement affidavit, child birth certificate (if available) or photo ID, and SSN/ITIN if you have it. If SSN isn't available, we can use the case number temporarily.
Alex Chen: Timeline question — if I submit today, can coverage be effective 2026-08-17? Need coverage for urgent meds starting next week.
Jamie (Benefits): If docs are submitted within 30 days of placement and they include the placement date, we can retroactively set medical/dental effective to 2026-08-17. If submission is after 30 days, effective date is generally the first of the month after approval.
Benefits Bot: Please fill out the Life Event form and upload docs here: https://hr.redwood.com/life-event. Accepted file types: PDF, JPG, PNG. Processing ETA: 3-5 business days.
Kristen R.: Heads-up on payroll: if coverage is retroactive there may be a retro premium catch-up. Payroll will default to spread the catch-up over the next 2 pay periods unless you request a lump-sum. Email payroll@redwood.com to request a different cadence.
Alex Chen: Thanks — I'll upload the placement letter and affidavit tonight. Does the foster agency need to include anything special?
Jamie (Benefits): If the placement letter lacks the child case number, please get a short email from the social worker that includes the case ID + placement date. Also note: if SSN isn't obtained within 60 days, we'll follow up to confirm documentation.
Maria (People Ops): If you run into issues uploading, you can send scanned docs via secure email to benefits@redwood.com and CC me. Happy to help with the form. :white_check_mark:
